source_definition_policy: Pinned author commit and Reactome 97; no response-dependent selection
hgnc_policy: Exact source symbol first; then exact HGNC approved symbol, or official exact previous symbol only when approved lookup is empty -> unique stable Ensembl ID -> unique original ID; no guessed aliases

single_cell_score.formula: log1p(10000 * sum(counts for unique mapped set genes) / sum(counts for all human genes))
single_cell_score.interpretation: Fixed marker expression score, not a cell-phase classifier or pathway-activity measurement

pathway_readout.denominator: Full original source member count, including unmapped entries; deduplicate mapped Ensembl IDs in numerator
pathway_readout.truth: Measured delta in the same selected gene subset, never PCA-reconstructed truth
pathway_readout.interpretation: Transcriptional response among covered genes; not enzyme activity or validated pathway activation
